text: 从企业规模看，大型企业PMI为50.6%，比上月上升1.1个百分点，高于临界点；中型企业PMI为49.4%，比上月下降0.3个百分点，低于临界点；小型企业PMI为47.9%，比上月上升0.5个百分点，低于临界点。
text_en: By enterprise size, large-enterprise PMI stood at 50.6%, up 1.1 percentage points month-on-month and above the threshold; medium-enterprise PMI was 49.4%, down 0.3 percentage points month-on-month and below the threshold; small-enterprise PMI was 47.9%, up 0.5 percentage points month-on-month and below the threshold.
